import os
import subprocess
import sys

from sase.vcs_provider import get_vcs_provider

checkout_target = {{ setup.checkout_target | tojson }}
project_name = {{ setup.project_name | tojson }}
gh_ref = {{ gh_ref | tojson }}

provider = get_vcs_provider(os.getcwd())

# Checkout the PR branch so that subsequent diffs are relative to the
# PR tip rather than the default branch. Try checkout_target first
# (works for default-branch refs like origin/main), then fall back to
# Patch name -> branch name conversion.
is_patch = checkout_target == f"origin/{gh_ref}"
ok, err = provider.checkout(checkout_target, os.getcwd())
if not ok:
    if is_patch:
        # Patch ref — resolve name to branch name
        resolved = provider.resolve_revision(
            gh_ref, project_name, os.getcwd()
        )
        ok, err = provider.checkout(resolved, os.getcwd())
    else:
        # Project/repo ref — try common default branch names
        for fallback in ["master", "main"]:
            ok, err = provider.checkout(fallback, os.getcwd())
            if ok:
                break
    if not ok:
        print(
            f"Warning: checkout failed: {err}",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )

# Sync with remote after checkout
subprocess.run(
    ["git", "pull", "--rebase", "--quiet"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)

# Record HEAD for the diff step
result = subprocess.run(
    ["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)
head = result.stdout.strip() if result.returncode == 0 else ""
print(f"head_before={head}")
print("success=true")

head_before="{{ checkout.head_before }}"
if [ -z "$head_before" ]; then
  exit 0
fi
head_now=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
diff_dir="${SASE_TMPDIR:-${SASE_HOME:-$HOME/.sase}/tmp}/gh-diffs"
mkdir -p "$diff_dir"
diff_file=$(mktemp "$diff_dir/sase-gh-XXXXXX.diff")
if [ "$head_now" != "$head_before" ]; then
  # Commits were made — show only the last commit's diff
  git diff HEAD~1 HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  commit_msg=$(git log -1 --format='%s' HEAD)
  echo "meta_commit_message=$commit_msg"
else
  # No commits — show uncommitted changes
  git diff HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -z 2>/dev/null \
    | while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
        git diff --no-index /dev/null "$f" 2>/dev/null
      done >> "$diff_file"
fi
if [ -s "$diff_file" ]; then
  echo "diff_path=$diff_file"
else
  rm -f "$diff_file"
fi

# Stash any uncommitted changes (including untracked files)
if ! git diff --quiet HEAD 2>/dev/null || [ -n "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard)" ]; then
  git stash push --include-untracked -m "gh-workflow-$(date +%s)" --quiet
  echo "stashed=true"
else
  echo "stashed=false"
fi
git fetch origin --quiet 2>&1 || true
git pull --rebase --quiet 2>/dev/null || true
echo "success=true"

from sase_github.scripts.gh_setup import main
main(
    gh_ref={{ gh_ref | tojson }},
    n={{ n | tojson }},
    release={{ release | tojson }},
    workflow_label={{ workflow_label | tojson }},
)

A test run of `bob periods draft 2026-W36 -n` accepted it at **237 words** without touching the vault. All 19 links in it point to notes or blocks that exist.
- **Headline:** "A 29h 25m week, 9h 38m below typical, gave sase 80% and closed three sase projects: CI and release, the Links panel, and `/sase_memory_write`."
- **Where the time went:** sase at 80% and gtd_daily at 10% (3h 01m, just over the 10% bar). The three gtd_daily rows are named without their minutes, because they add up to 3h 50m against the 3h 01m total.
- **Finished:** the three projects, which are exactly the three projects marked complete between Aug 31 and Sep 6. Then two tasks with their minutes, two gtd_daily rows, and `+more of 46 Done`, the same wording earlier weeks used.
- **Questions:** three. One asks about all three numbers running below typical. One asks about the "Updates" → "Setup" rename project, started Sep 2 and dropped Sep 5. One asks why the agents repo sync fix was dropped on Sep 5, the same day an epic relaunched to remove `agent_sync`.

**Left out because it couldn't be checked for that week:**
- Every "Still open, as of today" item. In the last vault commit of the week (Sep 6, 22:45), none of the four blocked projects was blocked yet, or the note didn't exist. The note holding the two refs kept 3× didn't exist either. The six bob tasks were created between Oct 27 and Nov 3, and the Disney Movie Night entry is a Nov 3 calendar event.
- An exact `+N more` count.
- Minutes for finished tasks that have since been moved to the `done/` notes. The brief doesn't credit them.
- Any claim about whether the days were reviewed: "Review closed" shows `–`, and every day is listed as not reviewed.

The brief problems W36 shows were all already recorded by earlier phases (gr.1, gr.3, gr.5, gr.7), so I proposed no new follow-ups. When the work runs, the plan adds one note to the bead with W36's evidence for those existing findings.
